description: This file defines the MerchantLogDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface for handling MerchantLog entities. It provides a method to list logs by a merchant store.

classes.name: MerchantLogDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for MerchantLog entities, supporting CRUD operations and listing logs by merchant store.

methods.name: listByMerchant
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MerchantLog entries associated with a given MerchantStore.
